circuit.name: Synchronous Buck DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: High-efficiency step-down DC-DC converter with synchronous NMOS rectifier replacing the freewheeling diode. Converts 12V input to 5V output at 0.5A load. Complementary PWM drives SW1 (PMOS high-side) and SW2 (NMOS synchronous rectifier) with 100ns dead time to eliminate body-diode conduction and improve efficiency over the diode-based buck.

requirements.requirement: Output voltage regulation at 5V target; verify ripple reduction from SW2 synchronous rectification
Efficiency analysis; compare synchronous rectifier conduction loss to equivalent diode Vf drop
Switch node voltage and peak current stress for SW1 and SW2

data.name: Vsw_max
data.description: Maximum switch node voltage including ringing
